desc:
🌀 SPIN INC

Upgrade every color, keep the circles spinning faster for higher multipliers and grow your multipliers to enormous numbers!

🔴 Buy upgrades for each color
✨ Prestige, an upgrade tree and Lines that earn you money (now with a 6th Blue Line)
♾️ Infinity, reset at the cap to earn IP and unlock a lot of new features like Infinity Charge
⚡ Infinity Charge: a charge that grows by itself and unlocks milestones
💪 Infinity Challenges: finish Challenge 10, Infinity Breaker, to Break Infinity and go past 1.8e308
🏁 Endgame: around 1e2100, until a new update
